parsed.explanation: The displayed inequality is false: D\{p} contains |D|-1 primes, so only 2^{|D|-1}≤w(D\{p}) follows. Replacing the exponent by |D|-1 yields 2^{|D|-1}<a_1, which still uniformly bounds |D|. Lemma 1 then makes the terminal family finite, and Lemma 2 places every prime occurring in a minimal accepted support inside a terminal member. Thus the finiteness mechanism is present, with a one-symbol error in its cardinality estimate.
